lines.zh: 我踩着碎石走，结晶在响。
lines.en: I walk over the rubble, my crystals chiming.

lines.zh: 我身上长着发光的源石。
lines.en: Originium glows on my body.

lines.zh: 我脚下的碎石被源石粘住。
lines.en: The gravel sticks to originium under my step.
The air thickens around me.

lines.zh: 我拖着步子，朝你那边去。
lines.en: I drag my steps toward you.
My limbs aren't very nimble.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草不长了。
lines.en: Nothing grows where I've walked.
I came out of the ore.
I hum as I walk.
I walk steadily with my head tilted.
The crystals chafe.
The ore grows slowly inside me.
I stand still while the originium glows.

lines.zh: 矿脉跟着我的调子轻轻震。
lines.en: The vein trembles softly to my tune.
I wait for the next sound.

lines.zh: 身上的结晶又长了一点。
lines.en: The crystals have grown a little more.

lines.zh: 我不需要呼吸，源石替我唱。
lines.en: I need no breath; Originium sings for me.
I listen to what moves under the ground.

lines.zh: 我身上那块源石，亮了一下。
lines.en: The originium on my body flickers bright.
This ground has gone very quiet.

lines.zh: 我在想着那首没唱完的歌。
lines.en: I'm thinking about the song I never finished.
Dust settles on my shoulder.
You heard it too, didn't you?
I look your way.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道是新鲜的。
lines.en: You smell fresh.
You'll end up like me.
I raise my hand, and it isn't a wave.
We're getting closer.
I'll sing it for you.
There's rust in your breath.
I see the lamp in your hand.

lines.zh: 你的轮廓被我唱进了矿里。
lines.en: I sang your outline into the vein.

lines.zh: 我身上的结晶掉了一块。
lines.en: A piece of crystal falls off me.
I stop for half a beat.
I shouldn't be able to feel pain.

lines.zh: 伤口里露出蓝色的矿脉。
lines.en: Blue vein shows in the wound.
The wound is slowly growing back.

lines.zh: 我身上的调子低了一度。
lines.en: My tune drops a note.
I hum the wrong note.
Dust shakes off me.
I've kept this note in mind.

lines.zh: 碎晶从我的下巴掉到地上。
lines.en: Broken crystal falls from my chin.

lines.zh: 你的食物会被矿灰盖住。
lines.en: Ash would cover your food here.
Put that away.
I only need the ore.
That isn't sustenance to me.
I take one step toward you.
What you're holding has grown heavy.
It isn't food I want to be near.
I lower my head and look.
This doesn't change anything.

lines.zh: 这段旋律，我唱了很多年。
lines.en: I have sung this melody for years.

lines.zh: 你撞到了我身上的结晶。
lines.en: You hit the crystals on me.
I sway, and don't stop.
Your hand has been cut.

lines.zh: 我不疼，我很久没疼过了。
lines.en: I don't hurt; I haven't for a long time.
Sparks jump between us.
I push back.
A shard falls to the ground.
You stepped back, and I'm still walking.

lines.zh: 落地的碎晶还在轻轻响。
lines.en: The fallen crystals still chime softly.
Between us we've stirred up the dust.
There are other sounds in the ore.
Another has walked out too.

lines.zh: 我们靠在一起，结晶互相磨。
lines.en: We lean together, crystals grinding.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，只哼同一段调。
lines.en: We don't speak, only hum the same tune.

lines.zh: 两个影子在矿上拖得很长。
lines.en: Two shadows stretch long over the ore.
The light on it is blue.

lines.zh: 我们把这片地变得很静。
lines.en: We make this ground very quiet.

lines.zh: 两段歌在矿洞里并成一段。
lines.en: Two songs merge into one in the mine.
I'll remember this tune.
The ore will keep growing.
I pick up that piece of originium.
It grows hot in my hand.
My song can sing stone awake.
It sinks in.
There's nothing I need to carry.
I toss it back onto the pile.
This belongs to me already.

lines.zh: 源石拿在手里，又放回原处。
lines.en: I take the originium and put it back.
It's still attached to my skin.
I take half.
I heard your footsteps.
I turn my head and listen to you sing.
You've walked onto this ore field.

lines.zh: 我的歌找到你的耳朵了。
lines.en: My song has found your ears.
I'm halfway through this verse.
The crystals in the air are moving.

lines.zh: 源石从我肩上朝着你长。
lines.en: Originium grows from my shoulder toward you.

lines.zh: 我的歌，走过的地方都听得见。
lines.en: My song carries wherever you walk.

lines.zh: 矿脉把这里都标了出来。
lines.en: The vein has marked this whole place.
You're starting to step back.
I raise my hand and the crystals brighten.

lines.zh: 这首歌唱到最后会很难听。
lines.en: The end of this song is ugly.
I've sung this line to its end.
Your shadow falls on the ore.

lines.zh: 我这副嗓子一唱，源石就醒。
lines.en: One note from me and the originium wakes.
This is the first line it taught me.
I come closer, one hum per step.
The crystals crack under my feet.

lines.zh: 梅菲斯特的歌，还没唱完。
lines.en: Mephisto's song isn't finished.
You've backed to the edge of the ore.
The song is getting closer.
There's a sweet metallic tang in the air.

lines.zh: 我的指缝里全是发亮的粉。
lines.en: Glowing dust fills the gaps between my fingers.
Listen — the beat has changed.
I go around that big outcrop.
The crystals on you are stirring.
Three more steps and I'm there.
I sing this line low.

lines.zh: 你每走一步，音就高一分。
lines.en: Each step you take lifts the note.

lines.zh: 我唱的歌，会拐进你的耳朵。
lines.en: My song slips into your ear.
I won't finish the last line.
I've reached my hand out.
The ore behind you is lighting up.
This song is for you.
Almost — only two blocks left.
Can you hear it clearly?

lines.zh: 我抬手打过去，结晶跟着。
lines.en: I swing, and the crystals follow.

lines.zh: 我的掌心按出一片晶纹。
lines.en: My palm leaves a pattern of crystal.
That knocks you back.
I press your shoulder.
Crystals have taken root on you.
I sing, and it sounds terrible.
You broke my rhythm for half a beat.
I step back and continue.
You've started to glow.
I shove you onto the ore.

lines.zh: 我的指节裂开，掉下碎矿。
lines.en: My knuckles crack and shed broken ore.
My hand has split open.
I wipe it and raise my hand again.
You're still standing — good.
Then never mind; I won't press it.
Then we carry on.
I bring my whole arm down.

lines.zh: 结晶沿着我的手爬到你身上。
lines.en: Crystals crawl from my hand onto you.

lines.zh: 这一击我用了身上的矿。
lines.en: I put the ore in me into that blow.
You fall back two more steps.
The seam splits, and I come out.
I stand covered in originium.
The ground here has started to taste wrong.
I hum one line first.
I don't know my own name.

lines.zh: 我从矿脉的裂口里挤出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out of the vein's split.

lines.zh: 我先哼了一句，调子是我自己编的。
lines.en: I hum a line first, a tune of my own making.
I take a step and crush a stone.

lines.zh: 第一声歌，从我喉咙的矿里出来。
lines.en: The first song comes from the ore in my throat.

lines.zh: 我第一次唱歌时，腿还在。
lines.en: When I first sang, I still had my legs.
I'm heading that way.
The ore grows along with me.

lines.zh: 火焰烤得我身上噼啪响。
lines.en: The flames make my body crackle.

lines.zh: 我从矿堆上滚下去，碎了一地。
lines.en: I roll down the ore pile, shattering.

lines.zh: 水让源石变冷，我开始僵硬。
lines.en: The water chills the originium and I stiffen.

lines.zh: 半边身子散了，歌还没停。
lines.en: Half my body scatters, but the song goes on.

lines.zh: 箭扎进我的胸口，卡在结晶里。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in my chest, stuck in the crystal.

lines.zh: 那股光比我的还亮，我退了。
lines.en: That light is brighter than mine, and I retreat.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可我在消耗自己。
lines.en: I don't eat, and I'm consuming myself.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，结晶全亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and every crystal lights up.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我一路沉下去。
lines.en: The ground is gone and I sink away.
